name: Mainspring Caldera
core_rationale: Central volcanic-brass crater of Continent 02 where Krono the Brass Titan's primary mainspring coil still beats, venting rhythmic steam plumes that drive the surrounding foundry towns.
local_conflict: Over-wound foundry automatons and ember-beetles have seized the main escapement bridge, threatening to over-pressurize the caldera vents.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Master smiths claim the heart of the Mainspring Caldera holds an uncracked Titan chronometer that can rewind a broken weapon to the day it was forged.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Concentric rings of glowing bronze flywheel bridges suspended above a steaming copper-slag crater.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Who wound the primary escapement lever during the Great Lantern Eclipse?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and forms the eastern high-level industrial heart of Continent 02 beyond Rustcog Downs.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Concentric bronze flywheel bridges suspended over a rhythmic steam-venting mainspring crater.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Designed around 14.0 meter bronze flywheel highways, 0.16 meter cog-risers, and 0.60 meter anvil counters for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting leaf node topology and foundry boss ecology before Canon promotion.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Includes complete mystery_hook for the uncracked Titan chronometer with zero filler maps.
